parts.name: Rotation
parts.Basic_description: This is the rotating cover part of the USB flash drive, made of aluminum alloy for durability and protection.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as a protective swivel cover that rotates to expose or shield the USB connector, preventing dust and damage.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around a pivot point to open or close over the USB connector.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the USB flash drive, made of ABS plastic, housing the electronic components and USB connector.
parts.Functional_description: It contains the memory chip and USB interface, providing the main structure and data storage functionality.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while the rotation part moves around it.
